notes.title: [Patch note Ver.1.40] Reduction of game load and overall adjustments
notes.notes:
Ver.1.20h > Ver.1.40
- Reduced resource load
- Fixed some graphics issues
- Added loading images
- Fixed display problems with overall score
- Adjusted sound volume
- Adjusted the movement of some enemy characters
- Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash when certain conditions were met
- Fixed some issues with the game concept
- Strengthened the blade of the "Kirisame Blade" 
  (Blade size is variable with blade energy)
- Additional game performance enhancements
- Reduced the load that occurs under certain conditions
- Implemented continue function for all the machines.

notes.title: [Patch note] Ver. 1.20f "KAMUI"
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=yIYiLOHmk3A;full][/previewyoutube]
Ver.1.10a → Ver.1.20f
[h2]The collaboration ship "KAMUI" is now available![/h2]
[h3]A new ship from the vertical scrolling STG masterpiece "KAMUI" has been added with its BGM.[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/283820/

In addition, 
[h2]Graze Counter GM, [/h2]
[h3]which features its ship "Kirisame Blade" in this game, has been released![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1486440/

Graze Counter GM features the "Nexalts" from this title.
Both of these collaborated ships will be opened under certain conditions, so please try them out!

Other fixes in this version:
- Added text strings in the name entry 
- Added name re entory. Press and hold the R stick at the main menu to go to the re-entry screen
- Added high scorer accolades page
- Added loading image
- Fixed a display bug in the total score
- Adjusted the sprite size of some bullets
- Adjusted DEF values of some enemy characters downward
- Fixed some enemy character explosions
- Changed "ZANGEKILL" effect.

notes.title: [Patch note] Ver.1.10a Additional fixes and implementations
notes.notes:
Ver. 1.01e > Ver. 1.10a
Made some additional fixes and implementations to improve the gameplay.

- Fixed some UI issues.
- Added risky blade bullets for some enemies.
- Adjusted the contact damage of some middle size enemies.
- Added "ZANGEKILL(斬）" bonus to some middle size enemies.
- Fixed an issue on some enemy characters' death.
- Added a warning to the surprise attack before the stage 2 boss.
- Fixed an issue with the timer (score subtraction) during boss battles.
- Reduced damage from collision with stage 4 boss (from 128 to 101)
- Fixed an issue with the stage 5 boss, and added a time limit (timer) from the start of the battle.
- The attack pattern of the final form of the last boss was partially changed.
- Fixed other minor display issues.

notes.title: [Patch note] Ver.1.01e Minor adjustments
notes.notes:
Ver. 1.01d > Ver. 1.01e
- Adjusted auto-bomb activation life value from 100 to 200.
- Fixed an issue in the 4th boss.
- Fixed an issue in the 5th boss. 
- Fixed a part of the last boss.
- Added play-results to the ending.
- Fixed some bugs in Kirisame Blade, and added a result instead of an ending.
- Added a function to start from the first stage without going through the main menu by pressing BACK+L or R+START in Pause menu.

notes.title: Demo version is released!
notes.notes:
Ahead of the release of the full game, a demo version of GRAND CROSS: ReNOVATION is now available to enjoy the dramatic prologue and stage 1. 
You can get it from the "Download Demo" link on the right side of the store page!
